name: Parallax photo
oneLiner: a still of the speaker splits into depth layers (a real night-street bokeh backdrop, a glow, a huge word, the cut-out person, foreground bokeh) and the camera makes a slow 2.5D push while focus pulls from the street to the face; the word slams in behind the head with a light flare, then a glass name tag lands
say: when the speaker introduces themself or a guest ('I'm...', 'meet the person who...') or names the one idea a section is about: the word lands behind the head on the name or the idea, the tag follows. Use a cut-out PNG (cutout.mjs makes one from any photo) and set word to the name or one strong word
